evidence: Source review against native build 1: this change makes POST /api/tickets/{id}/restart-worker a plain kill-then-start. It drops two refusals, adds a refusal for a Mac Ticket while the Mac is away, and adds one boolean, revision_restarted_in_fresh_conversation, to its response. It also removes the internal retirement_is_confirmed method from the conversation contract, which no route exposes. The iOS client calls no restart-worker route. A search of ios/ for restart-worker and its response fields finds nothing. Its Ticket calls (accept, reject, complete, backlog, resume, employee-configuration, conversation, workspace fields) are unchanged. The build floor is unchanged. Verification: the full unit suite (1,855 passed, 1 timing test that passes alone) and integration suite (150 passed, 1 timing test that passes alone) ran. No signed-device, TestFlight, or native reconnect checks ran for this ticket.
